facts.statement: The wiki team planned a recurring feature called Wiki Wednesdays that highlights and promotes wiki pages that are awesome or need help.
facts.quote: when we'll highlight and promote wiki pages that are awesome, or need help to become awesome

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Be a Contributor on the Official Free Realms Wiki)
article_summaries.summary: SOE's official Free Realms news post invites players to contribute to the official Free Realms wiki (FreeRealms.Wikia.Com) and announces a recurring 'Wiki Wednesdays' feature promoting wiki pages. It gives no game mechanics, items, or quest data; its main use is identifying the official community wiki and its sign-up requirements.
